subject: MATH251
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. For Arabic, one topic, 'Constructing a Circle Equation using Determinants', had no relevant videos available. For two other topics, the best selections had view counts below the 3000 threshold but were chosen under the exception rule due to the scarcity of more popular, relevant content. The selected videos for Linear Programming topics are particularly strong in both languages.
